macros.name: makeatmath
macros.doc: The command changes the category code of @ so that it can be used as the inline math environment.

macros.name: smeclearsym
macros.doc: Clear the style configuration associated with all symbols.

macros.name: smenewenv
macros.doc: Declares a “smart” math environment based on the traditional math environment provided in ⟨env name⟩.

macros.name: smeraw
macros.doc: The ⟨content⟩ of \smeraw will not be styled.

macros.name: smesetsym
macros.doc: The ⟨symbols⟩ given in the form of comma separated list will be styled using ⟨style csname⟩.
